warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3 at 3.00 + 3.00 (6.00); y = A-B-C-D at 2.00 + 4.00 + 4.50 (10.50). Origin A1. The same main chains print on both S-01 views, S-02, S-03 (T1 x / T2 y) and A-06/A-07. Vector CAD PDF with no text layer — every value read off the rendered page.

Grid-name conflict, decided: S-02 (แบบโครงสร้างหลังคา) prints FIVE row bubbles A, B, C, D, E with its 'D' at 9.00 and 'E' at 10.50, while S-01 (both views), S-03 Truss T2 and A-07 รูปตัด B all print four bubbles A, B, C, D with D at 10.50 and no named line at 9.00. Grid geometry follows the structural footing/column plan S-01 (op01 precedence 1) and four sheets against one (precedence 3): the 10.50 line is D, and the 9.00 tick is the dummy C''. Every S-02 ref is written in these names; positions agree exactly, only the letters differ.

C'' (9.00) is the S-01 tick 3.00 + 1.50 between C and D (beam B1 between PS and S1 in bay 1-2). It is C'' rather than C' because the Truss T2 chain puts a tick at 7.50 (1.50 below C) earlier in the same gap — dummy names follow position order (section 4).

Rule 4 dummies from the trusses: T1 panel points 1'' (1.50) and 2'' (4.50); T2 panel points B' (4.00), C' (7.50) and C'' (9.00, shared with S-01). 2' (4.20) is the S-01 1.20 + 1.80 tick and precedes 2'' in the gap.

A' (-1.00) vs A'' (-0.96) and D' (11.46) vs D'' (11.50) are 0.04 apart — kept both: they are different edges (A'/D'' = roof/rafter edge, 1.00 overhang on the S-02 plan; A''/D' = Truss T2 top-chord end, 0.96 overhang on the T2 elevation).

Two floating 1.30 chains on the S-01 structure view (stair ST-02 width along x, stair ST-01 width along y) end at member faces about 0.10 off the grid lines, not on any line — kept in dimension_chains with 'edge' ends and no new line (section 4 rule 4, floating chain).

z: ±0.00 = ระดับดินถม (A-06/A-07 and the A-01 notes). ระดับฝ้าเพดาน (A-06/A-07) and ระดับดินเดิม (S-04) print no value, so they are kept as levels with level_m null; the 1.00 / 0.50 / 0.05 / 0.05 footing depths below ระดับดินเดิม stay on the footing elements (S-04 file), not as z ticks. Truss heights (T1 1.89 / 1.03, T2 1.76 = 1.00 + 0.76) are member-internal and stay on the truss elements.

Dimension sweep covers the structural sheets S-01..S-05 plus A-06/A-07 (building sections, for levels). The other architectural/MEP sheets (A-03 floor/roof plan, A-04/A-05 elevations, A-08, A-09, E-01, SN-01, SN-02) were not dimension-swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run. S-04/S-05 print only member-internal dimensions (section sizes, cap sizes, slab thicknesses), which stay on their elements.
